full_judgment: 6. Mr. Fazlul Haque, learned Advocate for the appellant, has submitted that the alleged waqf deed dated 28th Kartik, 1323 BS was never acted upon as the waqif did not intend to create a waqf in respect of the suit property as he pursuant to an agreement for sale with his sons had meanwhile obtained an amount of Taka 500.00 to redeem the suit property from mortgage and disposed of the same on 19-11-1918 corresponding to 3rd Agrahayan, 1325 BS. The learned Advocate further submitted that the property since purchased by the 4 sons of Helimullah, the alleged waqif, who have been possessing the same as a secular property by mutating their names in the Khatian and as such, the suit property is not a waqf property as has been illegally found by the learned Additional District Judge, and the Waqf Administrator.
